levels.surface: أحمد بن علي بن عبيد الجعفي

notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» — a bare father (relation) and an unnamed collective, co-transmitters at level 1
«سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا» — the «سمع X» rule: the Imam named in the words is the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2)
«لِأَبِي» in the Imam's words is an addressee in the saying, not a link
